name: Soukoku no Kusabi Hiiro no Kakera 3 Asu e no Tobira
original_name: 蒼黒の楔 緋色の欠片3 明日への扉
source:
Fandisc of Hiiro no Kakera 3.

A year and a half after all the events, Tamaki and company (except Mahiro and Yuuichi, who have already graduated) are now approaching their high school graduation. Tamaki wants to go to the same university as Yuuichi but Ashiya tells her it would be easier for all of them if she went to the college of his organization instead, since this way she can be more safe as the Tamayorihime than in a public university. However, this makes Tamaki deeply lonely, since it means she and her guardians can't be together forever...

[edited from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2013/06/30/otome-game-review-soukoku-no-kusabi-hiiro-no-kakera-3-ashita-he-no-tobira/]Hinano's post[/url]]
translation:
《绯色的碎片3》的粉丝碟。

所有事件结束一年半后，珠纪一行人（已经毕业的真弘和祐一除外）即将从高中毕业。珠纪想和祐一上同一所大学，但芦屋告诉她，与其去普通大学，不如去他们组织的学校，这样她作为玉依姬会更安全，对所有人来说也更容易。然而，这让珠纪感到深深的孤独，因为这意味着她和守护者们不可能永远在一起……

[改编自[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2013/06/30/otome-game-review-soukoku-no-kusabi-hiiro-no-kakera-3-ashita-he-no-tobira/]Hinano的文章[/url]]
